\caption{\textbf{Training on added edges improves Goop rollouts, but risk still trails random placement.} Three paired seeds are trained from initialization for 100,000 updates. \textbf{A,} random25 position-coordinate MSE falls in every seed (30 complete H395 rollouts per seed and arm). \textbf{B,} risk minus random remains positive at 150 matched observed histories per model, although every gap narrows; risk uses the preceding observed base graph. Lines pair seeds; black bars mark three-seed means. \textbf{Endpoints and scales differ.} Across the full study, 1,077/1,080 rollouts complete; mixed seed-2 guards affect base, dense and cached risk. The mixed cached-risk full-horizon mean and its training interaction remain undefined.}
\label{fig:goop-exposure-placement}
\end{figure*}
